meta.title: AI News Feed
meta.description: DeepSeek Harness extension plugin. Delivers multi-source AI news aggregation, LLM-based intelligence scoring, S-tier discovery, and seamless conversation context injection.

ui.title: AI News Feed
ui.empty_desc: Click the button below to trigger real-time synchronization across all 6 sources.
ui.no_llm_notice: No LLM service detected. Showing raw multi-source stream. Configure LLM to enable AI scoring and summaries.
ui.budget_exhausted_notice: Daily model budget reached. New items are displayed raw and will refresh at local midnight.

get_top_ai_news.description: Retrieve recent high-signal AI news and research summaries

search_ai_signals.description: Search intelligence signals database by topic or keyword

trigger_feed_sync.description: Trigger automated fetching and scoring pipeline

get_feed_health.description: Get current health status, success rate, and storage stats of news sources

enable_briefing.description: Enable automated morning & evening AI intelligence briefings in the current session via dsh-schedule
enable_briefing.morning: Morning briefing dispatch time in HH:mm:ss format, defaults to 08:00:00
enable_briefing.evening: Evening briefing dispatch time in HH:mm:ss format, defaults to 20:00:00
enable_briefing.timeZone: IANA time zone name (e.g. Asia/Shanghai), defaults to system time zone

disable_briefing.description: Disable morning & evening AI briefings for current session to unblock session archiving

get_briefing_prompt.description: Retrieve standard prompt template for morning or evening AI briefing generation
